item.title: Color Detector Module
item.description: An Arduino color detector that flashes red, green, and blue light at a surface, measures the reflections with a single light-dependent resistor, and names the closest of 672 colors on an LCD.

item.title: Line-Following Robot & Starger Circuit
item.description: An autonomous line-following robot on a PCB I laid out, running register-level C on an ATtiny1634, which placed 3rd of 25+ in the class race with the fastest single run (44 s), plus the Starger race-starter and power-supply board.

item.title: Inductive Wireless Power Transfer
item.description: A modular inductive wireless power transfer prototype, tuned to resonance at 91 kHz, that delivered power across a gap at up to 63.9% efficiency, with a hand-wound phase-splitting transformer and coils.
